name: web-split-footer-with-blue-brand-panel-and-white-link-columns-with-newsletter
title: Split footer: a blue rounded brand panel with logo, tagline and social icons beside a white panel of four link columns and a newsletter field
whatItIs: A white page with a saturated blue rounded panel at the left holding a white logo, a bold 'Build Tastefully Crafted UIs', a row of white social icons and a copyright, and a bordered white panel at the right with four bold-headed link columns (Product, Resources, Company, Socials), a Newsletter heading and an email field with a black Submit button.
whatItMeans: Confident and organised; a colour panel gives a footer a brand anchor.
techniques: Split the footer into a brand panel and a link panel.
Pair the newsletter field with a black button.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured block holding logo and tagline.
A vertical list of links under a heading.
An email input with a submit button.
